$sources: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Appendix K (Anchoring to Concrete), Sec K.1-K.9, Eqs 6.K.1-6.K.32 (part 2 pp. 526-564, gazette pp. 4307-4345)
BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 10.10.9 (Anchor Rods and Embedments) (part 2 p. 138, gazette p. 3919)
source: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Appendix K (Anchoring to Concrete)

estimates.note: SAEngine practice, not a code value: geometry used when the anchor's own is not entered. The bearing area of a headed bolt's nut is taken as a hexagon of 1.5 d across the flats less the rod (the regular hex nut; heavy hex nuts are larger, so this is on the safe side); the thread pitch of the coarse metric series gives the threads per mm nt of Ase = π/4 (da - 0.9743/nt)².

sources.scope: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.2.1-K.2.4 (part 2 pp. 530-531, gazette pp. 4311-4312): cast-in and post-installed anchors; specialty inserts, through bolts, adhesive anchors and fatigue/impact loads excluded
sources.general: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.3.1-K.3.2 (part 2 p. 531, gazette p. 4312): elastic analysis; design strength not less than the largest required strength
sources.seismic: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.3.3-K.3.3.6 (part 2 pp. 531-533, gazette pp. 4312-4314): Seismic Design Category C or D: concrete modes × 0.75 assuming cracked concrete; steel of a ductile element to govern, or a yielding attachment, or 0.4 (stud bearing walls 0.5) × the design strength; not for plastic hinge zones
sources.concreteStrengthMax: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.3.5 (part 2 p. 533, gazette p. 4314): f'c not above 70 MPa (cast-in) and 55 MPa (post-installed)
sources.lightweight: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.3.4 (part 2 p. 533, gazette p. 4314): λ as Sec 6.1.8.1
sources.design: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.4.1.1-K.4.1.3, Eqs 6.K.1-6.K.2 (part 2 pp. 534-535, gazette pp. 4315-4316): φNn >= Nua, φVn >= Vua, the lowest of all failure modes
sources.applicability: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.4.2.2 (part 2 p. 536, gazette p. 4317): the breakout method holds for da <= 50 mm and hef <= 635 mm
sources.phi: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.4.4 (part 2 pp. 537-538, gazette pp. 4318-4319): ductile steel 0.75/0.65, brittle 0.65/0.60; concrete Condition A (supplementary reinforcement) / B; pullout and pryout always Condition B
sources.steelTension: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.1.2, Eq 6.K.3 (part 2 pp. 539-540, gazette pp. 4320-4321): Nsa = n Ase,N futa, futa <= min(1.9 fya, 860 MPa); Ase = π/4 (da - 0.9743/nt)²
sources.breakoutTension: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.2.1-K.5.2.2, Eqs 6.K.4-6.K.8 (part 2 pp. 540-542, gazette pp. 4321-4323): ANc/ANco ψec ψed ψc ψcp Nb, ANco = 9 hef², Nb = kc λ √f'c hef^1.5 (kc 10 cast-in, 7 post-installed), or 3.9 λ √f'c hef^(5/3) for cast-in headed anchors with 280 <= hef <= 635 mm
sources.narrowTension: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.2.3 (part 2 p. 542, gazette p. 4323): within 1.5 hef of three or more edges, hef is the greater of ca,max/1.5 and one third of the largest spacing
sources.eccentricityTension: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.2.4, Eq 6.K.9 (part 2 p. 543, gazette p. 4324): ψec,N = 1 / (1 + 2e'N / 3hef) <= 1, per axis, the product for two axes
sources.edgeTension: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.2.5, Eqs 6.K.10-6.K.11 (part 2 p. 544, gazette p. 4325): ψed,N = 0.7 + 0.3 ca,min/1.5hef below 1.5 hef
sources.crackingTension: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.2.6 (part 2 p. 545, gazette p. 4326): uncracked ψc,N 1.25 cast-in, 1.4 post-installed (kc = 7)
sources.splitting: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.2.7, Eqs 6.K.12-6.K.13 (part 2 p. 546, gazette p. 4327): ψcp,N = ca,min/cac >= 1.5hef/cac for post-installed anchors in uncracked concrete without supplementary reinforcement
sources.anchorReinforcement: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.2.9 and K.6.2.9 (part 2 pp. 547, 558, gazette pp. 4328, 4339): anchor reinforcement developed on both sides of the breakout surface replaces the breakout strength, φ 0.75
sources.pullout: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.3.1-K.5.3.6, Eqs 6.K.14-6.K.16 (part 2 pp. 548-549, gazette pp. 4329-4330): Npn = ψc,P Np, Np = 8 Abrg f'c (headed), 0.9 f'c eh da with 3 da <= eh <= 4.5 da (hooked), post-installed from ACI 355.2 tests; ψc,P 1.4 uncracked
sources.sideFace: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.5.4.1-K.5.4.2, Eqs 6.K.17-6.K.18 (part 2 p. 549, gazette p. 4330): headed anchors with hef > 2.5 ca1: Nsb = 13 ca1 √Abrg λ √f'c, × (1 + ca2/ca1)/4 for ca2 < 3 ca1; groups Nsbg = (1 + s/6ca1) Nsb for s < 6 ca1
sources.steelShear: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.6.1.2-K.6.1.3, Eqs 6.K.19-6.K.20 (part 2 pp. 550-551, gazette pp. 4331-4332): Vsa = n Ase,V futa (headed studs), 0.6 n Ase,V futa (headed and hooked bolts, post-installed); × 0.80 on built-up grout pads
sources.breakoutShear: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.6.2.1-K.6.2.2, Eqs 6.K.21-6.K.24 (part 2 pp. 551-553, gazette pp. 4332-4334): AVc/AVco ψec ψed ψc ψh Vb, AVco = 4.5 ca1², Vb = 0.6 (le/da)^0.2 √da λ √f'c ca1^1.5, le = hef <= 8 da; parallel to an edge twice the perpendicular value with ψed,V = 1; at a corner each edge, the least
sources.weldedShear: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.6.2.3, Eq 6.K.25 (part 2 p. 555, gazette p. 4336): 0.66 for cast-in anchors welded to an attachment at least max(10 mm, da/2) thick, s >= 65 mm
sources.narrowShear: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.6.2.4 (part 2 p. 556, gazette p. 4337): with three or more edges, ca1 <= the greatest of ca2/1.5, ha/1.5 and one third of the largest spacing
sources.eccentricityShear: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.6.2.5, Eq 6.K.26 (part 2 pp. 556-557, gazette pp. 4337-4338): ψec,V = 1 / (1 + 2e'V / 3ca1) <= 1
sources.edgeShear: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.6.2.6, Eqs 6.K.27-6.K.28 (part 2 p. 557, gazette p. 4338): ψed,V = 0.7 + 0.3 ca2/1.5ca1 below 1.5 ca1
sources.crackingShear: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.6.2.7 (part 2 p. 558, gazette p. 4339): ψc,V 1.4 uncracked; cracked 1.0, 1.2 with an edge bar of No. 13 or more, 1.4 with the bar inside stirrups at <= 100 mm
sources.thickness: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.6.2.8, Eq 6.K.29 (part 2 p. 558, gazette p. 4339): ψh,V = √(1.5 ca1/ha) >= 1
sources.pryout: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.6.3.1, Eqs 6.K.30-6.K.31 (part 2 p. 560, gazette p. 4341): Vcp = kcp Ncb(g), kcp 1.0 for hef < 65 mm, 2.0 otherwise
sources.interaction: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.7.1-K.7.3, Eq 6.K.32 (part 2 pp. 560-561, gazette pp. 4341-4342): full strength where the other ratio is <= 0.2, else Nua/φNn + Vua/φVn <= 1.2
sources.spacing: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.8.1-K.8.3 (part 2 p. 562, gazette p. 4343): spacing 4 da untorqued cast-in, 6 da torqued and post-installed; edges: the cover of Sec 8.1.7 (untorqued cast-in), 6 da torqued cast-in; post-installed 6/8/10 da
sources.postInstalledDepth: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.8.5 (part 2 p. 563, gazette p. 4344): hef of expansion and undercut anchors <= the greater of 2/3 ha and ha - 100 mm
sources.criticalEdge: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec K.8.6 (part 2 p. 563, gazette p. 4344): cac 2.5 hef undercut, 4 hef torque- and displacement-controlled
sources.anchorRods: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 10.10.9 (part 2 p. 138, gazette p. 3919): anchor rods resist the net tension of the column base moments, as threaded parts of Table 6.10.10; base shear by bearing or friction where possible
sources.momentBase: SAEngine practice, not BNBC (Sec 10.10.9 requires the rod tension from the base moment but gives no method): a rigid plate on a rectangular bearing block at the design bearing stress φc Pp / A1 of Sec 10.10.8, the rods on the tension side in equilibrium
sources.estimates: SAEngine practice, not a code value: the nut bearing area and thread pitch used when the anchor's own are not entered
